title: Public cantilever benchmark API
objective: Expose the public cantilever benchmark parameter object and runner after the elastic solver layer is proven.

plan_assets.asset_description: Phase E3 public cantilever benchmark scope.

scope: Add run_cantilever_benchmark to the benchmark package.
Keep mesh sizes configurable for smoke and nightly modes.
implementation_steps: Run GitNexus impact before editing benchmark package exports.
Add the public cantilever benchmark module and parameter dataclass.
Wire the runner to the internal elastic solver layer.
Export the public API from the benchmarks package.
Add API-level smoke tests without the full matrix.
acceptance_criteria: CantileverParameters supports configurable smoke and nightly mesh sizes.
No shared BenchmarkResult schema change is required.
risks: Adding exports can affect import contracts; mitigate with direct public import tests and GitNexus impact on benchmark __init__ exports.
completion_notes: Exported the public cantilever API from mechdsl.verify.benchmarks.
Kept BenchmarkResult unchanged and separated smoke/nightly mesh sizing.
